scripts.image:all: pnpm run image:web && pnpm run image:server
scripts.test:withbuild: pnpm run test && pnpm run image:all
scripts.release:snapshot: pnpm run image:all && PREFIX=v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")-snapshot-$(date +%y%m%d) && COUNT=$(git tag -l "${PREFIX}*" | wc -l | tr -d ' ') && NUM=$(printf '%02d' $((COUNT+1))) && TAG=${PREFIX}${NUM} && echo "Creating tag: $TAG" && git tag $TAG && git push origin $TAG
scripts.release: pnpm run image:all && TAG=v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && echo "Creating tag: $TAG" && git tag $TAG && git push origin $TAG
